title: data/costs.json
description: Prices, billing dates and auto-renew state. Hand-maintained: no dump reports what an invoice says. The LIST of servers and domains is derived from data/servers.json, so this file only supplies what a collector cannot see. Keys are vps:<server-id>, domain:<registrable-domain>, or any other id with a label.

currency.description: ISO 4217. One currency for the whole file; mixed currencies would need conversion this build step has no business doing.

label.description: Only needed for ids that are neither a known server nor a discovered domain.

plan.description: The provider's name for it, when it differs from what the specs imply.

provider.description: Who bills you. Hostinger, GoDaddy, Cloudflare.

amount.description: Renewal price per cycle, EXCLUDING tax — that is how the provider quotes it. null means not recorded, which renders as such rather than as zero.

tax.description: Taxes and fees on top of amount. Kept separate because the provider shows it separately and 18% GST on a ₹31k VPS is not a rounding error.

cycle.description: Normalised to a monthly figure for the total.

autoRenew.description: false means the service STOPS on expiresOn. That is a countdown to an outage, not a bill, and the dashboard raises an issue for it.

chargeOn.description: When money leaves the account. Providers charge days or weeks before expiry, so this is NOT expiresOn.

expiresOn.description: When the service stops if nothing is paid. The date that matters when autoRenew is false.
